title: gatewatch: constitution merged without explicit human review
description: Evidence: commit fc8348003399f3a211e90d3cce27a9725355c0c3 (2026-09-30), file docs/CONSTITUTION.md, lines 1-142 (added in full). Article IX requires changes to the constitution to have explicit human review and forbids riding an auto-merged PR. Git history provides no explicit human sign-off for this merged change; commit metadata alone is not such sign-off. Verify the merge gate and require explicit human review for constitutional amendments.

title: gatewatch: governance title claims workflow changes absent from diff
description: Evidence: commit fc8348003399f3a211e90d3cce27a9725355c0c3, subject 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 insertions, no workflow file). Article I requires merge subjects/descriptions to describe their diff truthfully. The subject claims automated workflow standardization, but the merged diff contains no workflow changes. Review the title/diff gate.
